div.head: Quadr I Cn Pr
div.ab: Hæc sunt instituta Cnudi, — — discrepat s. o. S. 279. 279***
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 535 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)

note.seg: hier beginnt Hk's alter Theil (und begann einst M)
here begins the old part of Hk (and M once began here)
Verf. hat Cn Pr. benutzt o. Arg. 2 ff. Er beginnt mit ihm als dem Vertreter der Laga Eadwardi (vgl. S. 533g), seines Hauptthemas, laut Arg. 1
The author used Cn Pr., see above Arg. 2 ff. He begins with it as the representative of the Laga Eadwardi (cf. p. 533 note g), his main theme, according to Arg. 1
